## Triage findings (2026-11-05)

**Fresh verification:** #5836 is OPEN, has no linked PR, and still lacks the decision record required by its body. It is **partially superseded, not fully handled**. Current GitHub main is 00a294a; this checkout's main is 8ad60f1. The nine-commit delta contains no pkgs/id changes, so the ID evidence below applies at current main. Parent #5677 remains OPEN and parked.

**Existing overlap:** doc/2026-10-30T13-25-00Z_design_friendly_name_references.md (lines 62–79) and pkgs/id/src/references.rs (lines 1–14, 222–238, 483–506) already specify and PoC-implement viewer-relative ranking for typed @/# reference resolution, including visibility filtering, match tiers and deterministic tie-breaks. That module explicitly says it is not production search. By contrast, pkgs/id/src/search.rs (lines 1–14, 163–183) is generic tag search: deterministic ID ordering, no full-text search, and no personalized ranking. Thus #5836 should not duplicate the reference-autocomplete design; general note-search ranking remains unhandled.

**Scoped path:** keep #5836 open as a design ticket for personalized general note search. Clarify that search surface against reference autocomplete, then decide own-edit-first behavior and whether it may cross existing match tiers; define its weight versus most-correct marks, recency and graph proximity; specify per-result explanations and graffiti demotion/filtering without erasing attribution/history. Preserve visibility-before-ranking and deterministic tie-breaks. Record the selected shape, rejected alternatives and invariants; do not silently reopen the parent’s reference, merge, sovereignty or approval decisions.

**Ordering / blockers:** finalize the parent #5677’s shared decisions first, then #5831’s foundational graph model/navigation API, then #5833’s fork-lineage and mark-most-correct semantics, then finalize #5836. The parent and #5833 are OPEN and parked. These are design-sequencing blockers, not grounds to close the issue; implementation timing remains separate.
